objectives.description: Convert all 18 task-reference occurrences under .memory/** to durable anchors or documented frontmatter exemptions

deviations.description: 17 of 18 occurrences were in frontmatter topic/source fields, not the memory body prose the task list anticipated
deviations.reason: A direct purge would falsify machine-written provenance data (memory-harvest.sh writes topic: "task-${task_number}" by design). Resolved by adding a new Exemption Taxonomy Category 7 to rules/no-task-references-in-deliverables.md and marking the 15 affected lines in place with an inline # task-ref-ok YAML comment, leaving field values byte-for-byte unchanged (verified via yaml.safe_load round-trip).
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — see plan Phase 10 task 2 note; new Category 7 documented per the plan's own directive to document newly discovered taxonomy categories rather than handle them ad hoc)*
